news.title: Franklin Templeton adds $150 million in fund shares to XRP Ledger, all in one wallet
news.summary: Two subscriptions on Thursday nearly quadrupled the fund’s tokens on the network. The receiving wallet shares its authorized signers with the issuer.

news.title: Robinhood sees surge in bitcoin, gold prediction markets as traders move beyond sports
news.summary: The company's head of futures and prediction markets said bitcoin, gold and oil contracts are among its fastest-growing prediction markets.

news.title: Bitcoin Core changes security rules as AI makes finding code bugs dangerously easy
news.summary: Developers merged a policy change that ends the months-long embargo for flaws a chatbot could rediscover, after a summer in which AI found hundreds of bitcoin bugs before the humans did.

news.title: Bitcoin's price is as jumpy as Nvidia's and eight times more turbulent than the euro
Live updates: Bitcoin holds above $81,000 as oil prices hit six-month high
news.summary: Brent crude oil surged above $116 per barrel for the first time since late April.

news.title: Bitcoin steadies near $81,700 as altcoins rebound, pepe climbs 13%
news.summary: Bitcoin rose 0.5% to around $81,700 since midnight UTC while the CoinDesk 80 gained 1.4% and memecoins climbed 2.9%.

news.title: Bitcoin appears to have decoupled from midterm cycle bottom history
news.summary: Previous bitcoin bear-market lows followed U.S. midterms, but this year’s recovery raises the possibility that the bottom arrived months earlier.

news.title: HSBC rolls out its first stablecoin to over 3 million everyday app users
news.summary: HSBC and Standard Chartered-led Anchorpoint received Hong Kong’s first stablecoin issuer licenses in April. Anchorpoint began rolling out HKDAP in August.

news.title: ‘Non-answers’ aren’t working. This is what investors really need from the Fed.
news.summary: What really matters to investors, economists say, is for Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh to prove he can successfully communicate the central bank’s strategy.

news.title: Do machines have feelings? AI has philosophers and tech leaders rethinking consciousness.
news.summary: As AI models become more advanced, tech leaders and philosophers are mulling the relationship between humanity and technology.

news.title: ‘She’s living the dream’: My stepmother said I can buy my childhood home for $850,000. Is she taking advantage of me?
news.summary: “My late father bought our house for $250,000 in the 1990s.”

news.title: My spouse was awarded $90,000 from my 401(k) in our divorce. How is that fair?
news.summary: “I retired in 2020 and subsequently went through a divorce a few years later.”

news.title: ‘I don’t feel sorry for myself’: I’m 64 and will be renting for the rest of my life. Is that so bad?
news.summary: “I married a wonderful man with a good income. He left his job due to health issues and suffered a massive stroke at 53.”

news.title: Will Anthropic pull off a November IPO? Time is running out to file key paperwork.
news.summary: If market pressures keep building, Anthropic “could reasonably decide it is better to stay private and wait for a better opportunity,” one portfolio manager says.

news.title: Investors piled a record sum into a leveraged semiconductor ETF last week. Things didn’t work out.
news.summary: Traders making bullish bets on chip stocks are getting walloped this month, as renewed fears emerged about investment returns on the buildout of artificial intelligence.
